name: Genova (V3)
author: NUMU
description: Genova (V3) — an editorial, strictly monochrome storefront built for denim. Wide image plates, hairline structure, no shadows and no accent colour, so the product photography carries the whole page. Ships denim-specific fit guidance, customer styling and store-visit sections.
description_ar: جينوفا (V3) — متجر أبيض وأسود بطابع تحريري، متعمل مخصوص للچينز. صور كبيرة وخطوط رفيعة، من غير ظلال ولا ألوان مميزة، عشان صور المنتجات هي اللي تقود الصفحة. فيه أقسام جاهزة لدليل المقاسات، ولوكات العميلات، وزيارة الفرع.

settings.headline: Built for the way you actually wear denim

settings.name: High-rise straight
settings.best_for: Sits at the natural waist and falls straight from the hip. The most forgiving cut if you are between sizes.

settings.name: Mid-rise slim
settings.best_for: Close through the thigh with a little give. Everyday denim that still holds its shape by evening.

settings.name: Wide leg
settings.best_for: Full from the knee down. Wears long — check the inseam against your usual shoe height.

settings.question: What payment methods can I use?
settings.answer: Card, InstaPay and cash on delivery. Whatever your store has switched on shows at checkout — you never see a method you can't actually use.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Message us as soon as you can. If it hasn't shipped yet we can change the size, the address or cancel it outright.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Most orders reach anywhere in Egypt within a few days of being dispatched. You'll get a message the moment yours is on its way.

settings.question: Do you deliver outside Cairo?
settings.answer: Yes — we ship nationwide. Delivery to governorates outside the main cities can take a day or two longer.

settings.question: I'm between two sizes. Which should I take?
settings.answer: For rigid denim take the larger size; it gives as you wear it. For anything with stretch take your usual size. The fit guide has the measurements for every cut, and you can always message us before you order.

settings.question: Can I exchange something that doesn't fit?
settings.answer: Yes. Keep it unworn with its tags on and get in touch — sizing is the most common reason for an exchange and we'd rather you had the right one.
